1→CC = gcc
     2→CFLAGS = -Wall -Wextra -std=c99 -I./include
     3→LDFLAGS = -lm
     4→
     5→# Directories
     6→SRC_DIR = src
     7→OBJ_DIR = obj
     8→BIN_DIR = bin
     9→TEST_DIR = tests
    10→
    11→# Files
    12→SOURCES = $(SRC_DIR)/main.c $(SRC_DIR)/types.c $(SRC_DIR)/codegen.c $(SRC_DIR)/ast.c $(SRC_DIR)/parser.c
    13→OBJECTS = $(SOURCES:$(SRC_DIR)/%.c=$(OBJ_DIR)/%.o)
    14→EXECUTABLE = $(BIN_DIR)/freelang-to-c
    15→
    16→# Minicc compiler
    17→MINICC_SOURCE = $(SRC_DIR)/minicc.c
    18→MINICC_EXECUTABLE = $(BIN_DIR)/minicc
    19→
    20→TEST_SOURCES_TYPE = $(TEST_DIR)/test_types.c $(SRC_DIR)/types.c $(SRC_DIR)/codegen.c
    21→TEST_SOURCES_EXPR = $(TEST_DIR)/test_expr.c $(SRC_DIR)/types.c $(SRC_DIR)/codegen.c $(SRC_DIR)/ast.c
    22→TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE = $(BIN_DIR)/test_types
    23→TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR = $(BIN_DIR)/test_expr
    24→
    25→# Phony targets
    26→.PHONY: all clean test test-all
    27→
    28→# Default target
    29→all: $(EXECUTABLE) $(MINICC_EXECUTABLE)
    30→
    31→# Create directories
    32→$(OBJ_DIR):
    33→	mkdir -p $(OBJ_DIR)
    34→
    35→$(BIN_DIR):
    36→	mkdir -p $(BIN_DIR)
    37→
    38→# Compile main executable
    39→$(OBJ_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.c | $(OBJ_DIR)
    40→	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
    41→
    42→$(OBJ_DIR)/test_%.o: $(TEST_DIR)/test_%.c | $(OBJ_DIR)
    43→	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
    44→
    45→# Link main executable
    46→$(EXECUTABLE): $(OBJECTS) | $(BIN_DIR)
    47→	$(CC) $(OBJECTS) -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)
    48→	@echo "✓ Built: $@"
    49→
    50→# Compile minicc
    51→$(MINICC_EXECUTABLE): $(MINICC_SOURCE) | $(BIN_DIR)
    52→	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(MINICC_SOURCE) -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)
    53→	@echo "✓ Built: $@"
    54→
    55→# Link test executables
    56→$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE): $(OBJ_DIR)/test_types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/codegen.o | $(BIN_DIR)
    57→	$(CC) $(OBJ_DIR)/test_types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/codegen.o -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)
    58→	@echo "✓ Built: $@"
    59→
    60→$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR): $(OBJ_DIR)/test_expr.o $(OBJ_DIR)/types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/codegen.o $(OBJ_DIR)/ast.o | $(BIN_DIR)
    61→	$(CC) $(OBJ_DIR)/test_expr.o $(OBJ_DIR)/types.o $(OBJ_DIR)/codegen.o $(OBJ_DIR)/ast.o -o $@ $(LDFLAGS)
    62→	@echo "✓ Built: $@"
    63→
    64→# Test targets
    65→test: $(TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE) $(TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR)
    66→	@echo "Running type tests..."
    67→	./$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE)
    68→	@echo ""
    69→	@echo "Running expression tests..."
    70→	./$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR)
    71→
    72→test-types: $(TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE)
    73→	./$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_TYPE)
    74→
    75→test-expr: $(TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR)
    76→	./$(TEST_EXECUTABLE_EXPR)
    77→
    78→# Run main program
    79→run: $(EXECUTABLE)
    80→	./$(EXECUTABLE) tests/fixtures/simple_types.fl -o /tmp/test.c
    81→	cat /tmp/test.c
    82→
    83→# Clean build artifacts
    84→clean:
    85→	rm -rf $(OBJ_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)
    86→	@echo "✓ Cleaned"
    87→
    88→# Help
    89→help:
    90→	@echo "Targets:"
    91→	@echo "  make all    - Build main executable"
    92→	@echo "  make test   - Build and run tests"
    93→	@echo "  make run    - Run transpiler"
    94→	@echo "  make clean  - Remove build artifacts"
    95→	@echo "  make help   - Show this message"
